firstPlayerRule: In the standard three-to-seven-player game, everyone starts together: each player secretly chooses a card, then everyone resolves their chosen action simultaneously.
clarifications: In the original two-player expert variant, the player to the left of the Free city begins with the Free city card and handles its first card choice. The normal action resolution remains simultaneous.
